AdminUpdateAppRequest edits mutable fields; app_key and key_prefix are
immutable (objects already live under the prefix). Absent optional fields

disables STS.

immutable. Credential fields are optional: absent = keep current
(edit endpoint/disabled without re-entering keys); present = replace.

AdminUpsertBucketRequest creates or fully replaces a bucket binding by
name. cdn must be resent on every update (absent = disable CDN).
Re-binding a bucket that still has objects to a different provider is
rejected — object rows carry (vendor, bucket) and would dangle.

(renewal keeps the token stable). 0 keeps the current value.

posture, same convention as the messaging/storage/license apps.

clears the empties. New tenants first seen on the trusted path are
lazily created with the wire-contract defaults.

regionId.description: region_id defaults to "cn-hangzhou" server-side when empty.

v1AliyunSmsCredentials.description: AliyunSmsCredentials configures an Aliyun SMS account.

v1ApiKeyInfo.description:
ApiKeyInfo is one tenant credential row. access_key ("ak_" + 12 base36,
spec §3) identifies the credential; the secret is stored as a bcrypt hash
and NEVER appears here — only CreateApiKey / RotateApiKeySecret responses
carry the plaintext, exactly once.

v1AuditAction.description: AuditAction represents types of auditable operations.

v1AuditLogEntry.description:
AuditLogEntry mirrors storage.AuditLogEntry. before/after are arbitrary JSON
(google.protobuf.Struct → swagger "object"); request_id is the trace id of the
audited operation, kept for the audit UI.

v1AuditLogStatus.description: AuditLogStatus represents the result of an audited operation.

v1AuditLogTargetType.description: AuditLogTargetType represents the kind of resource an audited operation touched.

v1AuthMode.description:
AuthMode selects the request-authentication posture of an app (spec §4.5).

 - AUTH_MODE_NONE: Public token only — lightweight SDKs may stay here.
 - AUTH_MODE_HMAC: Every batch must carry a valid X-Telemetry-Signature; failures are
dropped silently with a 204.

requestId.description:
request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

v1BucketACL.description: BucketACL represents bucket access control levels.

region.description: region defaults to "ap-singapore-1" server-side when empty.

v1ByteplusSmsCredentials.description: ByteplusSmsCredentials configures a Byteplus (intl) SMS account.

v1CDNConfig.description:
CDNConfig is a bucket's CDN fronting configuration. auth_key signs URLs
for Aliyun/Tencent-style CDN; key_pair_id is CloudFront-only (AWS S3 /
S3-compatible vendors).

requestId.description:
request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

v1ChannelAccountCredentials.description:
ChannelAccountCredentials carries the per-vendor credential set. Exactly
one arm is set; the vendor enum is implied by the arm. Secret fields
(keys/passwords) are echoed EMPTY on read — they are write-only.

name.description:
name uniquely identifies the account (referenced by policies), e.g.
"aliyun-main". Unique across all vendors.

credentials.description: credentials with secret fields EMPTY on read.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key marks a tenant-private account (phase ③ resource domain).
Empty = platform pool (usable by every tenant's policies).

v1ChannelAccountInfo.description: ChannelAccountInfo is a vendor account in the platform channel pool.

requestId.description:
request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

name.title: display name in the request locale

languageTags.title:
"" when the metadata has none — use as a phone
input placeholder / format hint

v1Country.description:
Country is one row of the ISO 3166-1 + E.164 directory. Field names use
the CLDR/libphonenumber "region" convention for the alpha-2 code — the
directory covers countries and other territories alike.

secret.description: new sk_…, shown once — never listed or echoed again.

name.description:
name uniquely identifies the account across vendors (referenced by
policies). Immutable after creation.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key optionally makes the account tenant-private (phase ③
resource domain). Empty = platform pool.

routes.description: routes is the ordered chain for EMAIL and CN-domestic SMS.

intlRoutes.description:
intl_routes is the ordered chain for international SMS. Optional: an
SMS policy with no intl chain rejects non-CN destinations at send time.

v1CreatePolicyRequest.description:
CreatePolicyRequest binds (app, channel, scene) to a template + route
chains. The (app, channel, scene) tuple is unique — creating a duplicate
returns an error.

name.description:
name is the signature string itself (CN, e.g. "XX科技") or the intl
sender ID (e.g. "MyApp"). Unique. Immutable after creation.

accountIds.description:
account_ids lists the channel accounts the signature is registered on
(报备). Full replace on every update; at least one binding required.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key optionally makes the signature tenant-private (phase ③
resource domain). Empty = platform pool.

v1CreateTemplateRequest.description:
CreateTemplateRequest creates a template from a full TemplateInfo
definition. template.id must be zero; template.app_id is overridden by
the top-level app_id (0 = shared).

v1CreateUserRequest.description:
---- Admin-Users (P2) ----
target user_id is kept; GetLoginLogs.user_id is an optional filter.

name.title: display name in the request locale

flagEmoji.title: issuer flag, e.g. "🇨🇳" — derived from the

v1DeviceType.description:
DeviceType categorizes the client device for session and audit metadata.
Inferred at login time from request headers / user-agent by the API gateway
and passed through.

 - DEVICE_TYPE_API: Machine-to-machine / direct API token (no UA).

v1EmailAddress.description: EmailAddress mirrors the downstream message (email + display_name).

v1EmailAttachment.description:
EmailAttachment drops the downstream `reserved` placeholders and renumbers
cleanly. url = caller-managed download reference (never fetched, metadata
only); content = inline bytes embedded as a real MIME part. Both may be
set (content embeds, url is record metadata). DB stores metadata only
(content is not persisted, so record echoes have it empty).

appKey.description: app_key identifies the calling app (authenticated sender identity).

v1EmailScene.description:
EmailScene represents the business purpose of an email. Required on every
send. Drives policy routing: (app, channel, scene) resolves the send policy
(template + ordered provider routes).

 - EMAIL_SCENE_LOGIN_CODE: One-time login verification code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_FORGOT_PASSWORD: Password reset link / code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_REGISTER: Registration verification code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_CHANGE_PASSWORD: Confirmation of password change.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_BIND_ACCOUNT: Bind a new email/identity to an account.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_NOTIFICATION: Generic transactional notification.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_VERIFY_EMAIL: Verify ownership of an email address.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_TEST: Ops-console test send (message admin UI).

v1EmailTemplateContent.description:
EmailTemplateContent is the EMAIL_RENDER template body. All three fields
support {{param}} substitution. html_body optional (plain-text-only send
when empty).

v1EmailVendor.description:
EmailVendor represents the email service brand. Each vendor offers SMTP
access today; an API path may be added per-vendor in the future. Vendor
is an audit label and (vendor, account) selection key — the underlying
transport is always SMTP. Vendors are configured in config.yaml; selecting
one with an unconfigured account returns ErrBadRequest.

 - EMAIL_VENDOR_ALIYUN: Aliyun DirectMail.
 - EMAIL_VENDOR_TENCENT: Tencent SES.
 - EMAIL_VENDOR_NETEASE: NetEase EasyMail.

v1EmailVendorStats.description: EmailVendorStats / SmsVendorStats mirror the downstream per-vendor breakdown.

v1EntitlementKind.description: EntitlementKind is the billing model of an entitlement entry.

v1FileInfo.description:
FileInfo is the user-facing file entity (mirrors storage.UserFileInfo; all
fields are file attributes — owner_type included because it is the file's
attribute, not the caller's identity).

v1Gender.description:
Gender is the user's self-reported gender. Stored as-is; no business logic
branches on it.

vendor.title: optional; validates bucket vendor when non-UNSPECIFIED

visibility.description:
visibility=PUBLIC lands in the configured public bucket
(public resources like avatars); UNSPECIFIED/PRIVATE keep bucket in charge.

requestId.description:
request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

timezoneName.title: display name in the request locale

regionGroups.description:
The country's group chain, continent first then sub-regions
(e.g. Asia -> Eastern Asia). Empty for territories outside the
served hierarchy (e.g. Antarctica sits under the unserved world root).

languages.description:
Official (incl. de facto official) languages, most-spoken first
(CLDR territoryInfo); e.g. zh-Hans for CN.

expired.description: expired = true: render an "attachment expired" page, download_url empty.

requestId.description:
request_id is optional; recorded in audit logs for traceability
(mirror of storage-service *Request.request_id).

v1Group.description: Group is an organizational unit; members inherit the group's roles.

v1GroupMember.description: GroupMember is a user's membership row within a group.

sign.description:
sign is the default signature bound to the Huawei app (Huawei carries
the sign on the account, not per request).

endpoint.description:
endpoint defaults to
"https://smsapi.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com" server-side when empty.

v1HuaweiSmsCredentials.description: HuaweiSmsCredentials configures a Huawei Cloud SMS account.

v1Identity.description:
Identity is a login method linked to a user (email, phone, each OAuth
provider, miniprogram openid).

v1IdentityProvider.description:
IdentityProvider identifies which login system a UserIdentity row belongs to.
Referenced by: Register.provider, BindIdentity.provider, SocialLogin.provider,
MiniProgramLogin (implicit WECHAT_MINIPROGRAM), and User.register_source.

Storage note: PHONE identities store ProviderUID as "<region_code>|<phone>"
(e.g. "CN|13800138000") so a single index covers region + local number.

ADMIN is not a real login method — it tags identities created by the
CreateUser RPC for audit purposes; Login never uses it.

 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_WECHAT: WeChat web OAuth (redirect-based).
 - IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ADMIN: Audit tag for CreateUser; not a login method.

v1ImageProcessOp.description:
ImageProcessOp mirrors the storage-service same-name message. type uses the
top-level ImageProcessType enum (int-identical to the downstream nested enum).

v1ImageProcessType.description:
ImageProcessType mirrors the nested storage-service ImageProcessOp.Type enum,
lifted to top level here so the generated swagger exposes a real named enum.
Values are identical, so the testkit↔storagev1 conversion is a plain int cast
(storagev1.ImageProcessOp_TYPE(req.GetType())).

v1ImageResizeMode.description:
ImageResizeMode controls how images are resized.

 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_FIT: lfit — fit within bounds
 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_FILL: fill — crop to fill
 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_PAD: pad — fit with padding

v1ItemError.description: ItemError is a per-file failure inside a batch upload-credential response.

v1KeyStatus.description:
KeyStatus is the lifecycle state of a license key. Revocation is a soft
state (rows kept); devices/entitlements survive and slots reattach on
unrevoke.

name.title: the language's name in the request locale

nativeName.title: endonym — the language's own name for itself

v1Language.description: Language is one selectable BCP 47 tag.

appKey.description: app_key identifies the app on every data-plane call; unique, immutable.

disabled.description: disabled apps fail every data-plane call immediately.

v1LicenseAppInfo.description:
LicenseAppInfo is one calling application of the licensing platform (a
business system identity, NOT an end-user license). Data-plane callers
present app_key/app_secret as x-app-key / x-app-secret metadata.

v1ListApiKeysResponse.description: ListApiKeysResponse NEVER carries a secret — see ApiKeyInfo.

v1LoginAction.description:
LoginAction classifies an entry in the login audit log (UserLoginLog.action).
Set by user-service at login time — callers never pass this value.

 - LOGIN_ACTION_LOGIN: Successful password Login.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_REGISTER: Register RPC or code-login auto-register.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_SOCIAL_LOGIN: SocialLogin on an existing user.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_SOCIAL_REGISTER: SocialLogin / MiniProgramLogin on a new user.
 - LOGIN_ACTION_BIND: BindIdentity (planned).
 - LOGIN_ACTION_UNBIND: UnbindIdentity (planned).

v1LoginFailReason.description:
LoginFailReason classifies WHY a failed audit-log row failed. Stored as the
int enum in user_auth_logs.fail_reason (the raw string column is gone) —
set by user-service, rendered as the enum name on the wire.

 - LOGIN_FAIL_REASON_VERIFY_FAILED: Account status / risk checks rejected the attempt.

method.description: The login method used; UNSPECIFIED for social logins (see user.v1).

username.description:
Denormalized at read time for list views; empty when user_id no longer
resolves (see user.v1).

target.description: The credential subject of the attempt (see user.v1).

appKey.description:
Tenant the attempt happened in (user_apps.app_key); "" on rows from
before tenancy.

v1LoginLog.description: LoginLog is one row of the login audit trail.

v1LoginMethod.description:
LoginMethod is the authentication strategy for the Login RPC.
PASSWORD methods verify a stored bcrypt hash; CODE methods verify a one-time
code from SendVerificationCode(purpose=LOGIN) and auto-register when the
identity is missing (response.is_new=true).

 - LOGIN_METHOD_PHONE_CODE: Auto-registers on missing identity.
 - LOGIN_METHOD_EMAIL_CODE: Auto-registers on missing identity.

captchaId.description: captcha_id returned by SendVerificationCode; required for code-based login.

v1LoginRequest.description:
LoginRequest is the curated frontend DTO for login. Field names line up 1:1
with user-service LoginRequest; the auth mapping layer int-casts the enums.

appKey.description:
app_key is the public credential identifier passed in x-app-key
metadata (e.g. "testkit"). Unique.

appSecret.description:
app_secret echoes the stored secret (internal-trust posture: plaintext
at rest, internal-network transport — the ops console needs to copy
credentials for service configuration, so it is list-visible rather
than show-once).

disabled.description: disabled apps fail every send with ErrAppUnauthorized.

smsDailyLimit.description:
Daily send-attempt caps (0 = unlimited). Counts attempts, not
deliveries; protects vendor accounts from runaway loops.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key is the tenant this app maps to (phase ③ dual-stack window).
Empty on rows not yet backfilled — the service falls back to the app_key
literal until T10 clears the empties.

v1MessageAppInfo.description:
MessageAppInfo is a registered calling application (the x-app-key
identity). Apps own policies; quotas and idempotency namespaces hang off
the app_key.

v1MessageStatus.description:
MessageStatus represents the delivery status of a message.

 - MESSAGE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED — never persisted.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_PENDING: PENDING — send in progress. Reserved for future async-send flow;
the sync flow does NOT write PENDING (currently unused).
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_SENT: SENT — the vendor synchronously accepted the send request.
For SMS: vendor API returned OK; does NOT mean handset received
         (async delivery is not tracked yet).
For email: SMTP server accepted the message.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_FAILED: FAILED — the vendor rejected the request, network/transport failed,
or context was cancelled. error_message carries the last error.

v1Module.description:
Module is a sellable module. player/storage/sound/environment/settings are
always free and never enter the entitlement system. The client-facing
trial/start request carries the module as the lowercase wire name
("downloads"/"tools", matching the client contract) and converts at the
service boundary.

v1MyQuota.description: MyQuota mirrors storage.QuotaInfo (read-only snapshot of the caller's quota).

v1OwnerStats.description: OwnerStats / ProviderStats / BucketStats are AdminGetStats aggregates.

v1OwnerType.description: OwnerType classifies who owns a file (user, system, group, etc.).

defaultRegion.title: alpha-2; disambiguates local-format input; empty = international format only

v1ParsePhoneRequest.description:
ParsePhone applies libphonenumber rules to raw input. Bad input never
fails the RPC: is_valid=false + error_reason carries the reason, and
guessable fields (region_code/dial_code) are still filled when the
region is inferable.

v1Permission.description: Permission is a resource:action catalog entry.

v1PermissionGroup.description: PermissionGroup is a named bundle of permissions.

v1PhoneType.description:
PhoneType classifies a parsed phone number by libphonenumber numbering
rules. Some regions cannot distinguish mobile from fixed line by prefix —
those report PHONE_TYPE_FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE.

templateId.description:
template_id references the template rendered for every send of this
policy. Its channel must match.

routes.description: routes is the ordered route chain for EMAIL and for CN-domestic SMS.

intlRoutes.description:
intl_routes is the ordered route chain for international SMS
(destination country != CN). Unused for email.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key is the tenant this policy belongs to (phase ③ re-keying:
unique per (tenant_key, channel, scene)). Empty on rows not yet
backfilled — resolved through the app mapping at load time.

v1PolicyInfo.description:
PolicyInfo binds (app, channel, scene) to a template and route chains.
Exactly one of email_scene / sms_scene is set, matching channel.

v1PolicyScene.description:
PolicyScene is the scene selector for policy payloads: exactly one field
set, matching the policy channel.

startedAt.title: process start time, Unix millis (client computes uptime)

v1Pong.description:
Pong is the standard health-check response shared by every servekit
service's Ping RPC — only public, non-sensitive info (service name, build
version, status, timestamps). Never include internal addresses, IPs, env
vars, secrets, or dependency topology here.

v1QuotaInfo.description:
QuotaInfo is an owner's storage quota (returned by GetMyQuota / SetOwnerQuota /
Admin*Quota). owner_type+owner_id are NOT here: GetMyQuota infers them from
ctx, the admin/owner-quota responses echo the request target implicitly.

v1RegionCode.description:
RegionCode mirrors messaging.v1.RegionCode (see user.v1-style mirroring:
testkit owns its wire types; the mapping layer is a plain field copy).

v1RegionGroup.description:
RegionGroup is one UN M49 node (continent or sub-region). The world root
(001) is not served; top level (parent_code == "") is continents. The
group identifier is numeric M49, so it is named group_code — "region_code"
is reserved for ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 across this API.

captchaId.description: captcha_id returned by SendVerificationCode; required to verify the code.

gender.description: Optional initial profile fields (mirror user-service RegisterRequest).

v1RegisterRequest.description: RegisterRequest is the curated frontend DTO for registration.

v1ResolveCodesRequest.description:
ResolveCodes is the batch by-code lookup across domains — one call serves
a registration form's validate-and-fetch. Timezone ids accept backward
aliases (normalized to canonical). Unresolved inputs land in missing_*;
the call itself never errors on unknown codes.

v1Role.description: Role is a named bundle of permissions assignable to users or groups.

secret.description: new sk_…, shown once — never listed or echoed again.

accountId.description: account_id references a channel account (the vendor pool entry).

signatureId.description:
signature_id references the signature used with that account.
Required for SMS routes (0 is invalid); unused for email routes.

weight.description: weight >= 1; higher weight = higher start probability. Default 1.

v1RouteRule.description:
RouteRule is one entry of a policy route chain. Chains are ordered;
the send picks a start by weight, then falls back along the list order.

appKey.description: app_key identifies the calling app (authenticated sender identity).

signName.description: sign_name is the SMS signature / intl sender ID the policy route used.

scene.description: Scene selects the message-service send policy (required).

templateParams.description:
TemplateParams render {{param}} placeholders — in the policy template
(template mode) or in the free-form content below.

subject.description:
Free-form content: subject non-empty → content comes from these fields
({{param}} still rendered); subject empty → policy template renders.

v1SendResponse.description:
SendResponse splits the downstream oneof vendor into two optional fields
(decision 6): exactly one of email_vendor / sms_vendor is non-zero.

scene.description: Scene selects the message-service send policy (required).

templateParams.description: TemplateParams feed the policy template's {{param}} placeholders.

content.description:
Free-form international SMS content ({{param}} rendered with
template_params; CN destinations reject it — vendor templates only).

v1SendVerificationCodeRequest.description:
SendVerificationCodeRequest is the curated frontend DTO for requesting a
verification code. The vendor template fields (sms_template_id, email_body,
...) live in user-service and are intentionally NOT exposed here — the BFF
supplies them from server config, not the frontend (design spec §3.2.2).

v1SendVerificationCodeResponse.description:
SendVerificationCodeResponse returns the captcha_id that binds the generated
code to this flow; it must be passed back to Register/Login.

loginMethod.description:
How this session authenticated (see user.v1): LOGIN_METHOD_* strategy;
social/mini-program logins stay UNSPECIFIED with login_provider set.

v1Session.description: Session is an active login session for the "manage devices" UI.

v1SessionStatus.description:
SessionStatus classifies a row in the session list: live rows come from
Redis (validate-on-use sliding window); historical rows come from the PG
tombstone table (user_sessions) once they leave Redis.

 - SESSION_STATUS_ACTIVE: in Redis; the sliding window is alive
 - SESSION_STATUS_REVOKED: explicit logout / revoke (revoked_at set)
 - SESSION_STATUS_EXPIRED: not in Redis, not revoked — TTL lapsed or evicted by the max-sessions cap

name.description:
name is the signature string itself (e.g. "XX科技") or the intl
sender ID (e.g. "MyApp"). Unique.

accountIds.description: account_ids lists the channel accounts this signature is registered on.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key marks a tenant-private signature (phase ③ resource domain).
Empty = platform pool (usable by every tenant's policies).

v1SignatureInfo.description:
SignatureInfo is an SMS signature (CN) / sender ID (intl), with the
accounts it has been pre-registered on (报备). A signature may only be
used with a bound account in a policy route.

v1SmsContentTemplate.description:
SmsContentTemplate is the SMS_CONTENT template body (intl raw-content
vendors), rendered platform-side with {{param}} substitution.

v1SmsScene.description:
SmsScene represents the business purpose of an SMS. Required on every send.
Mirrors EmailScene; VERIFY_PHONE is the SMS counterpart of VERIFY_EMAIL
(cross-channel pairs like VERIFY_EMAIL+SMS are rejected by SendSMS).

 - SMS_SCENE_LOGIN_CODE: One-time login verification code.
 - SMS_SCENE_FORGOT_PASSWORD: Password reset code.
 - SMS_SCENE_REGISTER: Registration verification code.
 - SMS_SCENE_CHANGE_PASSWORD: Confirmation of password change.
 - SMS_SCENE_BIND_ACCOUNT: Bind a new phone to an account.
 - SMS_SCENE_VERIFY_PHONE: Verify ownership of a phone number.
 - SMS_SCENE_TEST: Ops-console test send (message admin UI).

v1SmsVendor.description:
SmsVendor represents the SMS service brand. Path capabilities differ:
  - Domestic (CN) vendors: template-based only; raw content rejected.
  - International vendors split into:
      * raw-content (ALIYUN, VOLCENGINE intl, ...): caller supplies Content.
      * template-based (TENCENT intl, BYTEPLUS): caller supplies TemplateID + Params.
The service picks a path automatically from the destination region_code,
unless the request explicitly sets vendor + account.

 - SMS_VENDOR_ALIYUN: Aliyun (domestic + intl SendMessageToGlobe).
 - SMS_VENDOR_TENCENT: Tencent Cloud SMS (domestic + intl via SdkAppid).
 - SMS_VENDOR_VOLCENGINE: ByteDance Volcengine SMS.
 - SMS_VENDOR_BYTEPLUS: Byteplus (intl-only, template-based).
 - SMS_VENDOR_HUAWEI: Huawei Cloud SMS.

v1SmsVendorCodesContent.description:
SmsVendorCodesContent is the SMS_VENDOR_CODES template body: the
per-vendor code mapping. The params spec still applies — the same params
feed every vendor's template.

port.description: port defaults to 587 server-side when zero.

v1SmtpEmailCredentials.description:
SmtpEmailCredentials configures an SMTP email account. brand is an audit
label (which ESP the mailbox belongs to); transport is always SMTP.

returnTo.title: meaningful only for SocialLogin (OAuth callback flow)

v1SocialLoginResponse.description:
SocialLoginResponse is the shared response for all social-login RPCs.
token IS the session id; session_id mirrors it for direct targeting
(RevokeSession / GetSession).

v1SortDirection.description:
SortDirection selects ascending or descending order. UNSPECIFIED must be
treated as DESC by the service layer (preserves current behavior).

appKey.description:
app_key identifies the app on every data-plane call (x-app-key metadata);
immutable after creation.

keyPrefix.description:
key_prefix namespaces every object the app writes. Global unique,
immutable, must end with '/'. All key composition is plain concatenation.

bucketId.description:
bucket_id selects the app's private bucket; 0 = the platform default
bucket. PUBLIC uploads always land in the public bucket regardless.
Changing buckets only affects new uploads.

disabled.description: disabled apps fail every data-plane call immediately.

appSecret.description:
app_secret is the data-plane credential (x-app-secret metadata). Echoed
on every read — internal-trust posture, same convention as messaging
apps; the ops console is the intended reader.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key is the tenant this app maps to (phase ③ dual-stack window).
Empty on rows not yet backfilled — the service falls back to the app_key
literal until T10 clears the empties. New tenants first seen on the
trusted path are lazily created with key_prefix "{tenant_key}/".

v1StorageAppInfo.description:
StorageAppInfo is one calling application of the storage platform. Data
isolation is by key_prefix: every object an app writes lives under its
prefix (within the app's bucket, or the default bucket when bucket_id=0);
PUBLIC uploads land in the public bucket but keep the same prefix. The
prefix is the dedup domain — identical content under different prefixes is
stored (and deduplicated) independently.

defaultBucket.description: default_bucket receives uploads that do not specify a bucket.

publicBucket.description:
public_bucket receives visibility=PUBLIC uploads; empty = PUBLIC
uploads are rejected.

v1StorageSettings.description:
StorageSettings is the runtime-editable service-level settings row
(moved out of YAML config; managed via AdminGet/UpdateSettings).

v1TemplateChannel.description: TemplateChannel selects which send channel a template/policy belongs to.

tenantKey.description:
tenant_key scopes a template to one tenant (phase ③). Empty = shared
across all tenants (the former app_id = 0 semantics).

v1TemplateInfo.description:
TemplateInfo is a message template. app_id = 0 means shared across all
apps; otherwise the template belongs to that app's namespace.

v1TemplateKind.description:
TemplateKind selects how template content is stored and rendered.

 - TEMPLATE_KIND_EMAIL_RENDER: Email: platform renders subject/text/html with {{param}} substitution.
 - TEMPLATE_KIND_SMS_VENDOR_CODES: Domestic (CN) SMS: content lives at the vendor — the platform stores the
per-vendor template-code mapping only (regulatory: CN templates must be
pre-registered in each vendor console).
 - TEMPLATE_KIND_SMS_CONTENT: International SMS: platform renders raw content with {{param}}
substitution for raw-content vendors.

required.description: required params must be present in template_params on every send.

v1TemplateParamSpec.description: TemplateParamSpec declares one {{param}} placeholder of a template.

enabledCapabilities.description:
enabled_capabilities is a subset of the five service strings
USER / MESSAGE / STORAGE / TELEMETRY / LICENSE. gid/reference/portal
itself are platform plumbing and never appear here.

disabled.description: disabled tenants fail every tenant-scoped surface immediately.

v1TenantInfo.description:
TenantInfo is one platform tenant. tenant_key is THE tenant identifier on
every surface (spec §3: "ten_" + 12 base36, minted server-side, unique and
immutable) — no other alias or internal row id ever leaves the service.
Credentials never appear here; api keys are listed via ListApiKeys.

createdAt.description: Unix seconds; when the binding was created.

v1TenantMember.description:
TenantMember is one console-operator binding: a directory user authorized
to operate the tenant's console (actor.user_type = TENANT_ADMIN pinned to
this tenant). Display fields are joined from the user directory at read
time.

v1TenantMembership.description: TenantMembership is one console-operator binding of the caller.

region.description: region defaults to "ap-guangzhou" server-side when empty.

endpoint.description: endpoint is optional (e.g. a dedicated intl endpoint).

v1TencentSmsCredentials.description: TencentSmsCredentials configures a Tencent Cloud SMS account.

name.title: CLDR exemplar city in the request locale

v1Timezone.description: Timezone is one canonical IANA zone with its tzdb backward links.

isNew.description: is_new: this login auto-registered the account (code-login/OAuth paths).

returnTo.description:
return_to: business URL recorded at GetOAuthURL time (OAuth flows only;
empty for password/code logins).

v1TokenResponse.description:
TokenResponse is returned by every login-class RPC (Login, Register).
token IS the user-service session id (an opaque session token); session_id
mirrors it for testers targeting a specific session directly.

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3; "" leaves the stored value untouched.

regionCode.description: The user's country/region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); "" leaves it untouched.

v1UploadCredentialItem.description: UploadCredentialItem is oneof(token | error) for batch upload-credential items.

v1UploadFileMeta.description:
UploadFileMeta carries per-file upload metadata for BatchGetSTSCredential.
owner is absent — the BFF injects it from ctx.

fileId.title: non-zero when MD5 dedup hit (instant upload)

v1UploadTokenInfo.description:
UploadTokenInfo carries either an upload_token (client must ConfirmUpload
after the upload) or a file_id when MD5 dedup hit (instant upload).

dialCode.description:
Derived from region_code at read time, never stored — mirrors
user.v1.User.dial_code.

mfaEnabled.description: Reserved for MFA; false until an MFA flow exists.

appKey.description: Tenant label (user_apps.app_key) the user belongs to.

v1User.description:
User is the frontend-facing user shape (P2 enriched). Fields are renumbered
sequentially vs uservl.User (which has gaps from historical edits); the
mapping layer translates field-by-name, not field-by-number. Unlike P1's
6-field login view, this carries the full profile surface (status, gender,
timestamps, register_source, ...) used by profile/admin UIs. user_type is
retained so the frontend can still do its two-track split (design spec §3.5).

appKey.description:
app_key identifies the tenant on every tenant-scoped surface; unique,
immutable after creation.

appSecret.description:
app_secret is the tenant credential. Echoed on every read —
internal-trust posture, same convention as the other platform apps.

disabled.description: disabled tenants fail every tenant-scoped surface immediately.

v1UserAppInfo.description:
UserAppInfo is one tenant of the user platform (a calling application's
user directory). Tenants follow the platform-wide ak/sk pattern: app_key
is minted server-side ("usr_" + 8 base36), app_secret is the data-plane
credential presented as x-app-key / x-app-secret metadata by trusted BFFs
on login/register/admin surfaces — the tenant IS the verified caller.

v1UserRole.description: UserRole is one role held by a user (direct or group-inherited).

v1UserSortField.description:
UserSortField is the sort column for ListUsers / ListUsersPaged.
Default (UNSPECIFIED + descending=false) is equivalent to ID ascending.

 - USER_SORT_FIELD_ID: Default: snowflake id ascending.

v1UserStatus.description:
UserStatus is the account lifecycle state.
  - ACTIVE: account can log in (default after Register / SocialLogin / MiniProgramLogin).
  - DISABLED: account blocked; Login returns ErrUserDisabled.
  - PENDING_REVIEW: account created via CreateUser; user must call ChangePassword
    with the initial password to flip to ACTIVE before Login is accepted.

v1UserType.description:
UserType classifies every user by their relationship to the platform
rather than where they come from. Set at creation time; not user-editable.

 - USER_TYPE_END_USER: 租户的最终用户（原 USER_TYPE_NORMAL，值不变）。
 - USER_TYPE_PLATFORM: 平台员工/运营（原 USER_TYPE_INTERNAL，值不变）。
 - USER_TYPE_TENANT_ADMIN: 租户管理员：控制台操作者，钉死本租户。

v1UsersSummary.description: UsersSummary is the user-count aggregate from user.ListUsersPaged (count=true).

v1Vendor.description: Vendor classifies storage backends (cloud storage providers).

v1VendorTemplateCode.description:
VendorTemplateCode maps the template to one vendor's pre-registered
template code (CN domestic: codes live in each vendor console).

v1VerificationChannel.description:
VerificationChannel is the delivery channel for SendVerificationCode.
Decides which message-service API is called (SendEmail vs SendSMS) and which
template fields the request must supply.

v1VerificationPurpose.description:
VerificationPurpose binds a SendVerificationCode call to its consuming RPC,
preventing cross-context replay (e.g. a REGISTER code being reused to log in).
The (purpose, channel) pair must map to a valid scene in message-service —
e.g. VERIFY_PHONE on the EMAIL channel is rejected.

 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_REGISTER: Consumed by Register.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_LOGIN: Consumed by Login (code methods).
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_VERIFY_EMAIL: EMAIL channel only.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_VERIFY_PHONE: SMS channel only.
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_PASSWORD_RESET: Consumed by ResetPassword (TBD).
 - VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_BIND: Consumed by BindIdentity (TBD).

v1Visibility.description:
Visibility declares the intended audience class of an upload (avatar /
cover style "public resource" vs. default private). It maps to BUCKETS, not
per-file ACLs: objects are content-addressed and deduplicated globally, so
a physical object cannot be public for one referencing file and private
for another — bucket-level visibility is the only coherent granularity.
PUBLIC uploads land in the configured public bucket (public-read / CDN);
PRIVATE (and UNSPECIFIED, for backward compatibility) keep today's
behavior: the requested bucket, or the default bucket when unset.

region.description: region defaults to "cn-north-1" server-side when empty.

v1VolcengineSmsCredentials.description: VolcengineSmsCredentials configures a Volcengine SMS account.

v1WhoAmIResponse.description:
The caller is the verified actor (common.v1.RequestActor) carried in the
request context — no identity field on the wire.
